Wikipedia wordt bij iedere nieuwe racean: For each new race analysis, Wikipedia is consulted through Jolpica’s circuit link or a Wikipedia search, with caching for offline use. Names are attached only to a verified year-specific layout; candidates from tables remain unused until that association is checked. Historical names are labelled. Arrows follow the chronological measurement order of the lap. Start/finish is the measured lap start. Pit entry/exit markers indicate source-checked departure and rejoining zones on the main track, not an exact pit line or drawn pit lane. Missing source verification does not produce invented markers.
Bron: Jolpica publieke CSV-databasedump: Source: Jolpica’s public CSV database dump (14-day delay). The complete original ZIP is stored locally; SHA-256 was checked against the download catalogue. Every source entry and all available lap and pit records are retained unchanged in raw/race.json. Race numbers belong to this race, not automatically to a driver’s entire career.
Rondeposities zijn momentopnamen aan het: Lap positions are snapshots at the end of each lap. Missing values remain unknown. Pit duration is not interpreted as stationary time. The database supplies current team colours; older overviews use neutral colours unless historical colours have been verified.
Baanvorm uit een volledige gemeten ronde: The track shape comes from a complete measured lap by the winner, in sequential measurement order. OpenF1 coordinates have an arbitrary origin; no geographic orientation or distance in metres is claimed. Arc-length segments remain separate where track sections are close together. Both drivers need location samples before and after a record for a timing-based estimate. A source-confirmed corner may be anchored separately to validated year-specific geometry. Locations too far from the track or with excessive spread remain unknown. A corner confirmed in a report does not establish an exact overtaking point. Year-specific geometry is attached only when every corner anchor matches the measured track shape.
